scalars.scalar_value: Experience working in a research lab setting

items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Neuroscience, Psychology, Biology or related scientific field
Experience working in a research lab setting
Experience with rodent handling and behavioral research
Experience assisting with survival surges or animal research procedures

The Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior is seeking to hire a full-time Research Assistant to join the Hatos Center for Neuropharmacology with the Cahill Laboratory, a research program focused on understanding the neurobiology of pain, addiction, and related behavioral processes. You will support a variety of laboratory and animal research activities, contributing to studies that advance our understanding of brain function and disease. Key responsibilities include:
Support daily lab operations, including maintaining laboratory and behavioral research spaces
Assist with rodent behavioral studies and data collection
Participate in rodent handling and survival surgical procedures under supervision
Maintain vivarium records, laboratory inventories, and research supplies
Support laboratory compliance activities, including Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) inspections
Attend lab meetings and assist with data analysis and research-related projects
DLAM mouse training and/or rodent handling coursework
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Work and Excel
Ability to work effectively in a laboratory and team-based research environment
Knowledge of behavioral tracking and data analysis software, including AnyPaze and GraphPad Prism
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Familiarity with pain assessment models, addiction research, or behavioral neuroscience techniques
Ability to follow research protocols and maintain accurate records
